payload.title: IMP-SES-04: Move Sessions invocation prepare/command-Work/observe into private subservice
payload.exclusiveLease: pkg/services/factory_sessions/internal/services/invocation (create or relocate only this nested subservice)
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement Sessions invocation as a private nested subservice that prepares invocation input, commands Work, and observes completion behind the accepted CTR-SES root invocation slice and CTR-WORK peer root. Prove timeout, cancel, and partial-result behavior without taking identity, live-runtime, durable-execution, response-stream, or runtime-opening leases.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Sessions invocation prepare/command-Work/observe-completion lives under factory_sessions/internal/services/invocation (or the equivalent nested private subservice path required by FND-02).
Timeout, cancel, and partial-result cases return the typed failures and observable outcomes published by CTR-SES for the invocation slice.
Public Sessions root invocation behavior stays equivalent for representative success and typed failure cases already covered by CTR-SES characterization.

Work is commanded only through the accepted CTR-WORK peer root contracts; no Work implementation/module imports, Runtime/Petri types, or Wire/root construction ownership appear in the invocation subservice public surface.
A fake Work peer can exercise prepare/command/observe through the private implementation; focused invocation tests cover timeout/cancel/partial-result behavior.
Typecheck/lint and focused Sessions invocation tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Invocation subservice only; do not implement IMP-SES-01, IMP-SES-02, IMP-SES-03, IMP-SES-05, or IMP-SES-06 in this packet.
Do not edit CLI-manifest/generation owned by schema-cli-static-docs-models-mcp-migration (PR #1262).
Do not edit workers construction owned by standardized-provider-neutral-conductor (PR #1267).
Do not take CTR-RUN/CTR-REC/CTR-WRK leases or change public OpenAPI solely for package motion.
Do not expand into identity, live_runtime, durable_execution, response_stream, or runtime_opening directories.
Do not implement Work admission/staging/materialization; consume Work only via the accepted peer root.

payload.requestedOutcome: After IMP-SES-04 reaches terminal accepted evidence, reconcile the queue and decide whether to release further owner-local IMP packets unlocked by newly accepted CTR slices, PSS-F02 after F01 terminal, CTR-WRK after conductor clears, or hold for remaining CTR/CLI/provider gates.
